summary: iQSTEL Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a board-authorized share repurchase program for up to 1,000,000 shares of its common stock, funded in part by cash dividends from its subsidiary QXTEL. The program has no expiration date and will be executed through open-market purchases, privately-negotiated transactions, or block trades, subject to Rule 10b-18 and Rule 10b5-1 trading plans to blackouts. No price, premium, or timing specifics are disclosed; the program is flexible and market-dependent. Watch for periodic Form 10-Q/K disclosures on execution pace; no arbitrage angle given the discretionary nature.
